desc:
👗 Run your own fashion boutique! Design, sew and decorate dresses for customers, a real princess, and the Valley Fair! 👑

✂️ MAKE EVERY DRESS YOURSELF
Measure your customer, sketch the design, cut the pattern, sew each seam and pin it on the mannequin. Choose from 100+ bodices, sleeves and skirts and dozens of fabrics: satin, velvet, tulle, lace, glitter and prints!

🎀 DECORATE WITH FLAIR
Bows, pearls, lace hems, sashes, gems, tiaras and more, in any colour you like.

⭐ EARN 5 STARS
Every customer has a style, a favourite colour and a little wish. Get it right for big tips and reputation!

👑 STORY EVENTS
The Princess comes for a royal ballgown, and your rival Margaux keeps coming back to cause drama…

🏆 THE VALLEY FAIR
Enter your best dress every few minutes! Judges score it, players vote, and EVERYONE who enters wins prizes. Top designers win titles, Fair Ribbons and a pay boost, and walk the runway!

Join Our Community and Send me feedback! https://www.roblox.com/share/g/2636172
